Ordinary API bootstrap uses app.listen(port) with no loopback bind. If the development API socket is reachable from the LAN through firewall/proxy configuration, an already-authenticated and role/tenant-authorized staff actor could use second-factor-protected management routes without a second factor.

This does not bypass staff bearer/session, active-user, role, tenant, location or independent command authority. An external network path, actual opt-in process, and any successful remote HTTP use were not demonstrated. The issue is conditional developer-machine exposure, not proven production exposure.
